name: Republic of Venice
description: An ornate crimson banner bearing the golden winged Lion of Saint Mark within a decorative border, the fly cut into six pointed tails.
history: The banner of the Most Serene Republic of Venice, flown until the republic fell to Napoleon in 1797; the Lion of Saint Mark remains the emblem of the city and the Veneto.

features.role: ornamental golden border framing the hoist panel
winged Lion of Saint Mark holding a book
